title: Structs
instructions: A struct lets you group related pieces of data into one custom type. Think of a Person that has a name AND an age together.
You define the shape once with struct Person { ... };
Then you make one and fill it in. Use a dot to reach inside: p1.name, p1.age.
Structs keep related data bundled so you pass one thing around instead of many loose variables.
task: Set the age field to 33 so the program prints:  Sam is 33 years old
hint:
Reach inside with a dot and assign:

    p1.age = 33;
